funds_data.description: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar® U.S. Mid Cap Market IndexSM (the “underlying index”), which measures the performance of U.S. stocks issued by mid-capitalization companies. The stocks in the underlying index are weighted according to the total value of shares that are publicly owned and available for investment.
